b1-adj-haeufig: You go to the same bakery almost every morning, many times a week.
A teacher says this mistake is very widespread among learners. Many of them make it.
The doctor asks how regularly you get headaches. You answer: 'Many times a week.' Which adjective means 'frequent'?
b1-n-teilnehmer: Forty people join the language course. A man who sits in the room and takes part is one of them.
At the marathon, a man runs with a number on his shirt. He is one of the people who signed up.
The organiser of a conference counts everyone who registered. Which word means a male 'participant'?
b1-v-abschreiben: During the exam, a student looks at his neighbour's paper and copies the answers. The teacher is angry.
You copy the text from the board into your notebook by hand.
The company decides the old machine has lost its value and records the loss in its accounts. Which verb means 'to write off'?
b1-adv-heim: The party is over and it is late. You tell your friends you are going back to your own house. Which small word do you add after 'go', like 'home'?
After work you drive straight to your own flat. You tell your colleague: 'I am going ___ now.' Which word means 'home' as a direction?
A child is lost in town. The policeman says he will take him back to his family. Which adverb means 'home' as a direction?
b1-n-risiko: Before you ski off the marked track, the guide warns you about the possibility of something going wrong.
Your friend wants to put all his savings into one new company. You say there is a chance he will lose everything.
Smoking increases the possibility of getting sick. Which word means 'risk'?
b1-n-therapie: After a car accident, you go to a clinic three times a week to do special exercises for your back.
A psychologist talks with you every week to help you with your fears.
The doctor plans a course of medical treatment for your illness over several weeks. Which word means 'therapy'?
b1-adj-stolz: Your daughter wins first prize in the school competition. You watch her on stage with a big smile and feel very happy about her success.
A man built his own house with his own hands and looks at it, very pleased with himself.
A father says he is full of pride for his son. Which adjective means 'proud'?
b1-n-voraussetzung: A job ad says you must have a university degree before you can apply. That is the first thing needed.
To join the advanced course, you must first pass the beginner exam.
The bank says it will lend you money only on one condition. Which word means 'prerequisite'?
b1-v-versprechen: Your child asks you to come to his school play. You say: 'I will definitely be there, I give you my word.'
A friend asks you to keep something to yourself. You say: 'I swear I won't tell anyone.'
Your boss assures you that you will get a raise next year. Which verb means 'to promise'?
b1-n-bewegung: The doctor says you sit too much and should do more physical activity, like walking every day.
A dancer's arms and legs flow in beautiful graceful steps across the stage.
A car stands still, and then it starts to roll forward. Which word means 'motion'?
b1-n-dreck: After playing in the garden in the rain, the kids' shoes are covered in wet earth and mess.
The floor in the kitchen is really filthy, and you must clean it.
The mechanic's hands are black with oil and grime. Which word means 'dirt'?
b1-v-rennen: The bus is leaving in one minute. You move as fast as you can on your legs to catch it.
A dog chases a ball across the park at full speed.
In the 100-metre race, the athletes sprint to the finish line. Which verb means 'to run' fast?
b1-n-kursleiter: At the evening school a man stands in front of the class, teaches the course and makes the schedule.
You have a question about the cooking course timetable, so you ask the man in charge of it.
A man organises and leads the yoga course at the community centre. Which word means a male 'course leader'?
b1-adj-dankbar: A stranger helped you carry your heavy bags up the stairs. You feel very thankful for the help.
After the operation, the patient tells the nurses how happy he is for all their care.
You tell your parents that you appreciate everything they did for you. Which adjective means 'grateful'?
b1-n-summe: You add 12, 8 and 5 and get 25. What do you call the result of adding numbers?
A bank letter mentions a large amount of money, five thousand euros, that you will get.
The teacher asks for the result of the addition. Which word means 'sum'?
b1-v-bekanntgeben: The school director stands in front of everyone and tells the names of the winners for the first time.
The company tells all its employees who the new boss will be.
The couple tells their families publicly that they are getting married. Which verb means 'to announce'?
b1-n-fussgaengerzone: In the city centre there is a street full of shops and cafés where cars are not allowed. Only people on foot walk there.
You walk with your child along a car-free shopping street with street musicians.
A tourist asks where the area is in town where only walkers may go. Which word means 'pedestrian zone'?
b1-n-heim: Your grandmother can no longer live alone. She moves to a place where nurses look after old people.
Children without parents live together in a house run by an organisation.
A sign says 'Old people's ___'. Which word means 'home' as an institution?
b1-adj-doppelt: You order a coffee and ask for two shots of espresso in it, a quantity twice as big as usual.
The price this year is two times as high as last year.
The teacher says you must write the word two times. Which adjective means 'double'?
b1-adv-spaetestens: Your boss says the report must be on his desk on Friday at the very latest, not a day later.
The train leaves at nine. You tell your friend to be at the station by quarter to nine and not later.
You say you will call back by tomorrow evening, not later. Which adverb means 'at the latest'?
b1-n-breite: You measure the table. It is two metres long and 80 centimetres from side to side.
A tailor measures how far your shoulders go from one side to the other.
A road sign warns that vehicles over a certain size across are not allowed. Which word means 'width'?
b1-v-entwickeln: A team of engineers creates a new type of engine over several years.
A child slowly grows and changes into a confident teenager as the years pass.
You bring a roll of old film to a lab so the pictures can be made. Which verb means 'to develop'?
b1-n-faehre: To get your car across the river, you drive onto a big vessel that carries cars and passengers.
On the way to the island, you stand on the deck of a large ship with cars parked below.
A ship takes cars and people regularly from one shore to the other. Which word means 'ferry'?
b1-n-arbeitsstelle: You are reading the ads because you want a new position where you can earn money.
After a year without work, you finally find a position at a supermarket.
Where do you go every morning at eight to do your work? Which word means 'job' or 'workplace'?
b1-v-siegen: In the final match, our team scores more goals and takes the cup.
After a hard match, the tennis player is the victor.
In fairy tales, good always beats evil in the end. Which verb means 'to triumph'?
b1-n-technik: The engineer is excited about new machines and electronic equipment in the factory.
A piano teacher shows you the right way to move your fingers over the keys.
At school you choose a subject about machines and electronics. Which word means 'technology'?
b1-adj-uebrig: After the party, only two slices of pizza stay on the table.
You pay your bills and check how much money is still there at the end of the month.
Everyone got a cookie and there is one more. Which adjective means 'left over'?
b1-n-rasen: Children play football on the short green grass in the garden.
On Saturday you cut the green grass in front of the house with a mower.
A sign in the park says: 'Do not walk on the ___.' Which word means 'lawn'?
b1-n-gift: The label on the bottle shows a skull. If someone drinks it, he could die. What kind of substance is that?
A snake bite can be dangerous because of what the animal injects into you.
A farmer puts out something harmful to kill the mice in the cellar. Which word means 'poison'?
b1-v-langweilen: The film is so slow that after twenty minutes you look at your watch because nothing interesting happens.
You sit alone at home on Sunday with nothing to do and nothing to watch. How do you feel?
The teacher's long talk makes the students yawn. Which verb means 'to bore'?
b1-n-kunststoff: Bottles, toys and bags are often made of this light material that factories produce from oil.
The jacket is not leather. It is made of a man-made material.
Where do you put empty yoghurt cups made of artificial material in your recycling? Which word means 'plastic'?
b1-n-empfang: You arrive at the hotel and go to the desk in the lobby to get your key.
Your radio sounds terrible in the mountains because the signal is weak.
At the company, visitors register at the desk by the entrance. Which word means 'reception'?
b1-adj-sogenannt: You say: 'My ___ friend never came to help me.' You doubt that he really is a friend.
A news article writes about 'experts' whose titles you do not believe. You use a word meaning 'so named'.
Which adjective, placed before a name, means 'so-called', as in 'the ___ Silicon Valley'?
b1-v-vertrauen: You give your house keys to your neighbour while you are on holiday because you believe he is honest.
A child holds her father's hand and knows he will never let go.
You can depend on your best friend, and you say you believe in her completely. Which verb means 'to trust'?
b1-n-hut: It is sunny, so you put something with a brim on your head to protect yourself from the sun.
The magician pulls a rabbit out of his black headwear.
A cowboy wears a wide-brimmed one on his head. Which word means 'hat'?
b1-n-aufnahme: In the studio, the band plays the song and the engineer saves the sound on a computer. What is the result?
The new student is welcomed and accepted into the school.
You take a quick photo of the family at the beach. Which word means 'snapshot'?
b1-adv-nebenbei: While cooking, you also listen to a podcast, doing both at the same time.
You mention something small and unimportant while talking about another topic: '___, I met Anna yesterday.'
A student works part-time at a café in addition to studying. Which adverb means 'on the side'?
b1-v-entstehen: A big city grows slowly where once there were only fields. How does it come into being?
When hot and cold air mix, thunderstorms can form.
A fire starts in the kitchen, and the investigators want to know how it came about. Which verb means 'to arise'?
b1-n-tagesablauf: A reporter asks you to describe your day from waking up to going to bed: breakfast, work, lunch, evening.
A nurse writes the order of activities for each day for the patients.
At the language exam you must talk about what you normally do from morning to night. Which word means 'daily routine'?
b1-adj-roh: Sushi is made with fish that has not been cooked.
The meat is still red inside and not yet cooked.
Before you bake a cake, the dough is not baked yet. Which adjective means 'raw'?
b1-n-qualifikation: A job ad lists the training certificates and degrees you need in order to apply.
A nurse shows the papers that prove she completed the training required to work.
An athlete's good result means he has earned a place at the Olympic Games. Which word means 'qualification'?
b1-n-margarine: You do not put butter on your bread, but something made from vegetable oil.
A vegan cake recipe asks for a plant-based spread instead of butter.
At the supermarket you look for the yellow plant-based spread near the butter. Which word means 'margarine'?
b1-v-fuettern: Every morning you give the dog his bowl of food.
A mother gives her baby porridge with a spoon.
At the zoo, visitors throw food to the ducks. Which verb means 'to feed'?
b1-n-linie: In art class you draw a long thin mark with a ruler from one corner of the page to the other.
At the bus stop you ask which route number goes to the city centre.
On the road, a white painted mark separates the lanes. Which word means 'line'?
b1-n-ausdruck: You click 'print' and a paper with your ticket comes out of the printer.
The teacher says that a certain word or phrase is too informal for an essay.
A novel contains many unusual phrases. Which word means 'expression' in this sense?
b1-adj-vernuenftig: Instead of spending your whole salary at once, you save half. People say you are acting sensibly.
You stay at home when it storms and do not drive. Your mother says it is a wise decision.
Your friend always makes good choices and thinks before acting. Which adjective means 'reasonable'?
b1-v-zerstoeren: A storm blows down trees and wrecks the whole garden. Nothing is left.
A child kicks over the tower of blocks that his sister built for hours.
A fire burned the old library to the ground. Which verb means 'to destroy'?
b1-n-strafzettel: You come back to your car and find a paper under the wiper. You parked in a no-parking zone and must pay a fine.
A camera flashes as you drive too fast, and a letter with a fine arrives at home.
A paper on your windscreen says you did not pay for parking. Which word means '(parking) ticket'?
b1-n-wahrheit: In court, the witness promises to tell what really happened, nothing invented.
You ask your child who broke the window and you want the real facts, not a lie.
The opposite of a lie is what is real. Which word means 'truth'?
b1-n-gedicht: In literature class you read short lines that rhyme and describe spring.
For his wife's birthday, he writes a few rhyming verses about their love.
A famous writer wrote many short pieces in verse. Which word means 'poem'?
b1-v-sich-wundern: You see your quiet neighbour dancing in the street at midnight and find it very strange.
You open the door and find that the cleaner has already left, though it is early. You are astonished.
Your friend says she is surprised that the shop is still closed at noon. Which verb means 'to be surprised'?
b1-n-badewanne: After a long cold day you fill a big tub with hot water and relax in it.
In the bathroom, the baby is washed in a big white basin by the wall.
The plumber says the water drains slowly from the large tub in your bathroom. Which word means 'bathtub'?
b1-adj-untersagt: A sign at the pool says that running around the pool is not allowed.
In the hospital smoking is strictly banned. The rule is written on the door.
A notice at the museum says taking photos is not permitted. Which adjective means 'forbidden'?
b1-adv-raus: A room is full of smoke. You open the door and tell your friend: 'Let's get ___ of here!'
You tell the dog: 'Go ___ of the kitchen!', so he leaves the room.
Your friend is inside a shop and you wait on the street. You call to him to come outside. Which small word means 'out'?
b1-n-gas: You cook on a stove with blue flames. What does the stove burn?
You press the pedal on the right in your car to go faster.
A balloon floats because it is filled with a light substance that is neither liquid nor solid. Which word means 'gas'?
b1-v-umtauschen: The shoes you bought are too small. You bring them back to the shop to get a bigger size.
At the airport you hand over dollars to get euros.
Your sweater has a hole. You take it back with the receipt to get a new one. Which verb means 'to exchange'?
b1-n-ueberstunde: Tonight you stay at the office until 8 pm, two hours after your normal work time ends.
At the end of the month your boss pays you for the hours beyond your contract.
Your timesheet shows one more hour than the 40 you must work. Which word means 'hour of overtime'?
b1-n-feuerzeug: A smoker takes a small gadget out of his pocket and makes a flame to light his cigarette.
You need a small flame to light the candles on the cake, but you have no matches.
It is a small plastic device with gas that makes a flame when you press a button. Which word means 'lighter'?
b1-adj-befriedigend: After the exam you get the grade '3', which is not great, but it meets the standard.
After a long day of hard work, finishing the project gives you a feeling of satisfaction. It feels rewarding.
Your result is neither very good nor bad, just enough to meet the standard. Which adjective means 'satisfactory'?
b1-v-sichern: Before leaving, you lock your bike with a strong chain so that nobody steals it.
You copy your photos to a hard drive so they will not be lost.
Climbers fix a rope to the rock for safety. Which verb means 'to secure'?
b1-n-frisur: At the hairdresser you tell her you want it short on the sides and long on top.
For the wedding she has her hair arranged in an elegant way.
You say: 'I like your new style of hair.' Which word means 'hairstyle'?
b1-n-koenig: In a fairy tale, a man with a crown rules the country from his castle.
On a chessboard, the most important piece is the one that must be protected.
In a pack of playing cards, a card with a crown and a beard ranks higher than the queen. Which word means 'king'?
b1-n-arbeitslosigkeit: The news says many people in the country cannot find any paid work this year.
After the factory closed, the town has many people without jobs.
The number of people without work is going up. Which word means 'unemployment'?
b1-v-anschliessen: You plug the printer into the computer with a cable so that they work together.
Your friends are going hiking and you ask if you can come along and be part of the group.
The electrician hooks the new oven to the power supply. Which verb means 'to connect'?
b1-n-muehe: You work very hard to carry the heavy suitcase up five floors. It takes a lot of energy.
Your neighbour thanks you for helping him move house. You say it was no bother at all.
A friend thanks you for all the trouble you took to organise the party. Which word means 'effort'?
b1-adj-allgemein: A doctor gives a talk that applies to most people, not just to you.
The rule is valid for everyone, not only for a few.
The teacher gives a broad overview without details. Which adjective means 'general'?
b1-n-frist: The tax office gives you until 31 July to hand in the form. After that date it is too late.
The library lends you the book for four weeks, and you must bring it back in that time.
Your application is due by Friday and no later. Which word means 'deadline'?
b1-v-ausstellen: A museum puts a painter's pictures on the wall so visitors can see them.
The registry office writes out and gives you a new certificate.
The doctor writes a note for your employer. Which verb means 'to issue' a document?
b1-n-boot: You sit in a small vessel on the lake and move it with two oars.
Fishermen go out to sea early in the morning in their small vessel.
At the harbour many small sailing vessels float on the water. Which word means 'boat'?
b1-adv-ebenfalls: The waiter says: 'Enjoy your meal!' and you answer: 'Thanks, the same to you!'
Your friend says she likes pizza and you add that you like pizza too.
Your colleague is going to the meeting and you say you will be there as well. Which adverb means 'likewise'?
b1-n-menue: At the restaurant the waiter hands you a list of dishes to choose from.
The lunch special includes a soup, a main dish and a dessert for one price.
On the website, you click the button at the top to open a list of pages. Which word means 'menu'?
b1-adj-verrueckt: He wants to swim across the lake in winter. Everyone says the idea is completely mad.
Your friend wants to paint his car pink and green with stars. You think the idea is totally wild.
The traffic is so terrible that it drives you out of your mind. Which adjective means 'crazy'?
b1-n-ec-karte: At the cash machine you put in a plastic card with a chip to get money from your bank account.
In the shop you tap a card on the terminal to pay directly from your bank account.
The cashier asks if you pay in cash or with the card linked to your current account. Which word means 'debit card'?
b1-v-ausfallen: The teacher is ill, so today's lesson will not take place.
As people get older, their hair can start to come off the head.
A football player was injured and cannot play this season. Which verb means 'to drop out'?
b1-n-nachteil: The flat is cheap, but it is far from the centre. That is a negative point.
A pro-and-con list has two columns: advantages and the opposite.
Working at night gives you less time with your family. Which word means 'disadvantage'?
b1-n-vermietung: An agency gives flats to tenants for a monthly payment. That is its business.
A sign at the beach says you can get umbrellas and boats for a fee for a day.
Your landlord puts out an ad that his flat is available to tenants. Which word means 'renting out'?
b1-v-verpacken: You put the glasses in a box with paper so they do not break in the post.
At the gift counter the assistant covers your present with colourful paper.
Before moving house, you put your books into cartons. Which verb means 'to pack'?
b1-n-magazin: At the newsagent you buy a glossy weekly publication with pictures about cars.
The bookshop has a room at the back where extra books are stored.
A science publication comes out every month. Which word means 'magazine'?
b1-adj-besonderer: Tonight is your anniversary, so you cook something unusual that you never make normally.
A shop has a one-off offer for someone with a very rare need.
The teacher gives a student a little extra help because he has a different need. Which adjective means 'special'?
b1-n-sand: At the beach, children build castles from the tiny grains under their feet.
A builder mixes cement with fine grains from the river.
In an hourglass, tiny grains fall slowly from top to bottom to measure time. What are they?
b1-v-loesen: In maths class, you finally find the answer to a difficult problem.
The knot in your shoelace is too tight, so you pull it to loosen it.
Two friends argue and then talk it through to end the dispute. Which verb means 'to resolve'?
b1-n-landwirtschaft: Your uncle grows wheat and keeps cows and chickens on his land.
She studies at university how to grow crops and keep animals as a profession.
This area is known for fields, tractors and barns. Which word means 'farming' as a sector of the economy?
b1-n-kapitel: You read a novel and stop at the end of one section, then turn the page to a new heading with a number.
In a textbook, the contents page lists the numbered main parts.
The teacher says: 'Open the book at the next numbered section.' Which word means 'chapter'?
b1-n-doppelbett: At the hotel, the room for a couple has one big bed for two people.
You tell the receptionist that you and your wife want one bed for two, not two separate ones.
In the furniture shop, you want a wide bed for two adults. Which word means 'double bed'?
b1-adj-toedlich: Some mushrooms in the forest are so poisonous that eating them can kill you.
A doctor says an illness can end in death if it is not treated.
A sign on a high-voltage pylon says it is a danger to life. Which adjective means 'deadly'?
b1-v-widersprechen: Your boss says the meeting is on Monday. You say that is wrong and that you think it is on Tuesday.
Your friend says something you disagree with, so you tell him that you see it differently.
A witness's second story says the opposite of her first story. Which verb means 'to contradict'?
b1-adv-wieso: Your friend did not come. You ask 'how come?' because you want to know the reason.
A child asks his father about the sky being blue. Which question word does he use to ask for the reason?
You ask your colleague for the cause of his lateness. Which question word means 'why'?
b1-n-zusammenhang: The detective notes that the two robberies are linked, with the same time and the same street.
You read only one sentence from a long text, so you do not understand it without the surrounding text.
Doctors found a link between sleep and health. Which word means 'connection'?
b1-n-ober: In a restaurant, you wave your hand and call the man who brings the food.
A man in a black vest carries plates and takes your order.
When you want to pay the bill, you call for him in the traditional way. Which word means a male 'waiter'?
b1-v-fordern: The workers want a higher salary and tell the boss that they insist on it.
The customer says his money must be paid back immediately, and he does not accept a no.
The customers shout that the shop must give back their money. Which verb means 'to demand'?
b1-n-stewardess: On a plane, a woman in uniform shows you how to use the life jacket and serves drinks.
She works in the sky, takes care of the passengers and checks that seat belts are fastened.
A girl dreams of travelling the world as a woman who serves passengers on flights. Which word means 'stewardess'?
b1-adj-betrunken: After too many beers at the party, he cannot walk straight and speaks unclearly.
A driver who has had too much alcohol must not drive.
The man staggers home after a night in the bar. Which adjective means 'drunk'?
b1-n-meister: A man who completed the highest craft exam in carpentry runs his own workshop.
He won the national chess tournament and is the best player in the country.
At a factory, the man in charge of the workers on the production floor gives the orders. Which word means 'master' or 'foreman'?
b1-n-drogerie: You buy shampoo, toothpaste and soap in a shop that has no prescription medicines.
You need cotton pads and baby products, so you walk to a shop nearby that sells cosmetics.
Which shop sells cosmetics, hygiene products and household cleaners? Which word means 'drugstore'?
b1-v-gelingen: You tried to bake a cake for the first time and it came out perfectly.
After many attempts, you finally manage to open the jar.
The surgeon says the operation was a success. Which verb means 'to succeed' when something works out?
b1-n-dialekt: The old man in the village speaks differently from the television. His local way of speaking has its own words.
People from Bavaria and from Hamburg say words in different ways, though they speak the same language.
In Bangladesh, people in different regions speak in local ways that others hardly understand. Which word means 'dialect'?
b1-n-kampf: Two boxers stand in the ring in front of a crowd for a sports contest.
The patient's long struggle against illness lasted years.
The small shop owner makes a constant effort to survive against the big supermarket. Which word means 'struggle'?
b1-v-genuegen: You ask if ten euros is enough to buy the ticket. The clerk says yes, that will do.
The teacher says a pass mark is enough. You do not need a top grade.
A short note is all that is required. Which verb means 'to be sufficient'?
b1-adj-schmal: The alley is so thin that only one person can walk through at a time.
The bridge is not wide. Two cars cannot pass.
She has a thin face and long thin fingers. Which adjective means 'narrow'?
b1-n-begruendung: You get a letter rejecting your application, and it says why. You read the reasons given.
The teacher asks you to explain why you chose that answer.
The boss asks for the reasoning behind your request for a day off. Which word means 'justification'?
